project.title: Launch of Unified Self-Service Support Portal
project.objective: Design and launch a unified self-service support portal that reduces inbound calls and improves digital customer experience across web and mobile.
deliverables: Customer self-service portal MVP with responsive web UI
Knowledge base structure and initial content set
Search and FAQ experience integrated with existing systems
Call deflection and usage analytics dashboard
Support team training materials and quick-reference guides
constraints: MVP must go live within 30 days
Portal must comply with accessibility and data protection standards
Reuse existing authentication and CRM systems; no new core platforms
Content must be maintainable by non-technical staff
Support hours and SLAs cannot be impacted during rollout

risks.risk: Low adoption of the portal by customers leading to minimal call reduction.
risks.mitigation: Involve call centre agent in FAQ design, run in-queue promotion, and monitor early usage to iterate quickly.

risks.risk: Scope creep on features delaying MVP launch.
risks.mitigation: Define a strict MVP feature list, log extras in a post-launch backlog, and enforce change control in weekly reviews.

risks.risk: Content becomes outdated or inconsistent across channels.
risks.mitigation: Define content ownership, review cadence, and approval workflow with clear governance guidelines.

risks.risk: Technical integration issues with existing authentication and CRM.
risks.mitigation: Software architect and web developer create early integration spike and technical proof-of-concept before full build.

risks.risk: Accessibility or compliance gaps discovered late in the project.
risks.mitigation: Apply accessibility checklist from the start and schedule an early compliance review of the prototype.

themes.why_relevant: Keeps the team focused on must-have features to hit the 30-day launch deadline.
Ensures the portal actually reduces call volume and improves customer experience.
High-quality, up-to-date content is critical for self-service effectiveness.
Portal must integrate with existing auth and CRM without disrupting operations.
A clear, accessible interface drives adoption and reduces confusion.
Analytics and feedback loops are needed to iterate after launch.

backlog.task: Define MVP feature set and success metrics for the self-service portal
definition_of_done: MVP feature list documented and agreed by all stakeholders
Success metrics defined (e.g., target call deflection, portal usage)
Scope and metrics shared in channel and stored in project doc

backlog.task: Map top call drivers and draft initial FAQ topics
definition_of_done: Top 20 call reasons identified from recent support logs
Initial FAQ topics and question list drafted
List reviewed with web content manager and assistant lecturer

backlog.task: Design information architecture and navigation for the portal
definition_of_done: Site map and navigation structure created
User flows for key tasks (search, FAQ, contact) documented
IA validated with call centre agent and web content manager feedback

backlog.task: Define technical architecture and integration approach
definition_of_done: High-level architecture diagram produced
Integration points with auth and CRM identified and documented
Technical risks and assumptions logged and shared

backlog.task: Implement portal front-end and basic navigation
definition_of_done: Responsive front-end built for home, FAQ, and search pages
Navigation and layout match approved wireframes
Basic accessibility checks passed on key pages

backlog.task: Set up content templates and publishing workflow
definition_of_done: Standard templates for FAQ, how-to, and announcements created
Draft workflow for content creation, review, and publishing defined
Workflow validated with call centre agent and assistant lecturer

backlog.task: Create and review initial FAQ and how-to articles
definition_of_done: At least 25 FAQ and 10 how-to articles drafted
Content reviewed by call centre agent for accuracy and clarity
Accessibility and tone-of-voice guidelines applied

backlog.task: Design visual style and interaction patterns
definition_of_done: Style guide with colors, typography, and components created
Interactive prototypes for key flows shared with team
Feedback from at least three stakeholders incorporated

backlog.task: Implement search and FAQ filtering functionality
definition_of_done: Search bar and filters implemented on FAQ page
Search returns relevant results from knowledge base
Performance and basic error handling validated

backlog.task: Configure analytics and call deflection tracking
definition_of_done: Analytics events defined for key portal actions
Dashboard or reports configured for usage and deflection
Data validated against sample user sessions

backlog.task: Prepare support team training and quick-reference materials
definition_of_done: Training deck and quick-reference guide drafted
Call centre agent reviews materials for practicality
Training plan and schedule agreed with support manager

backlog.task: Run pre-launch content and UX review
definition_of_done: Content checked for accuracy, broken links, and formatting
UX walkthrough completed with digital media designer and call centre agent
List of critical fixes documented and assigned

artifacts.used_for: Captures agreed MVP features, non-goals, and success metrics for the project.

artifacts.title: Top Call Drivers and FAQ Mapping
artifacts.used_for: Maps frequent call reasons to proposed FAQ topics and content owners.

artifacts.title: Content Style, Tone, and Accessibility Guide
artifacts.used_for: Defines writing style, tone, and accessibility rules for all portal content.

artifacts.title: Portal Information Architecture and User Flows
artifacts.used_for: Documents site map, navigation, and key user journeys for the portal.

artifacts.title: Technical Architecture and Integration Plan
artifacts.used_for: Describes system components, integrations, and technical decisions.

artifacts.title: Pre-Launch Content and UX Review Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensures content, UX, and accessibility checks are completed before go-live.

artifacts.title: Portal Analytics and Call Deflection Dashboard
artifacts.used_for: Tracks portal usage, search behavior, and estimated call deflection over time.

artifacts.title: Knowledge Base Governance and Workflow
artifacts.used_for: Defines roles, workflows, and review cadence for maintaining content.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on MVP scope, success metrics, and responsibilities.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the self-service portal project and asking for scope alignment.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the MVP feature list and explicitly park non-MVP items.
Agree on 2–3 primary success metrics for the MVP launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prioritise top call drivers and confirm initial FAQ set.
threads_plan.trigger: Call centre agent shares draft list of top call reasons and proposed FAQs.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the initial set of FAQ topics to include in the MVP.
Assign content ownership for each FAQ topic.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in information architecture, UX approach, and visual style.
threads_plan.trigger: Digital media designer posts IA and wireframes for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the proposed navigation structure and key user flows.
Confirm accessibility and mobile responsiveness requirements.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Confirm technical architecture, integrations, and analytics setup.
threads_plan.trigger: Software architect shares draft architecture and analytics plan.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the technical architecture and integration approach.
Agree on the analytics events and reporting cadence post-launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan pre-launch checks, training, and go-live date.
threads_plan.trigger: Web content manager posts proposed pre-launch checklist and timeline.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm MVP scope and go-live readiness criteria using the checklist.
Validate that content owners are ready to maintain articles after launch.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup where each member posts yesterday/today/blockers.
Twice-weekly MVP scope and risk check-in thread led by software architect.
Weekly content and UX review focusing on new FAQs and user feedback.
Pre-launch readiness review using the checklist one week before go-live.
Post-launch metrics review every week using the analytics dashboard.
